_readme: Labelled anchors for the semantic (stage-2) scope guard. Data as data: the
policy lives here, not in Python, so widening scope is a reviewable diff.
label = in_scope | out_of_scope. hazard (in_scope only) is the supported
hazard a paraphrase maps to, reported as `hazard_hint`; null means
answerable background earth-system science that names no supported hazard.
topic (out_of_scope only) is the name the refusal reports.
Authored from the DEV set's phrasing plus paraphrases the lexical stage
provably misses ("storms getting stronger"). The held-out test set was not
